Thesis: niche aerospace components roll-up; revenue +36-39% y/y last two quarters, operating margin 18%->24%, insiders bought ~$14M in the last year (incl. a director $4.9M). Rich on trailing P/E (85), ~39x forward. Break: organic growth stalls or margins fall back below 20%.

Thesis: Omnipod tubeless pump share gains; revenue +23-34% y/y, op margin 16-19%, every valuation ratio at the bottom of its 5-year band (P/E 26 vs median 88). Insider buys $2.9M. Break: growth < 15% or GLP-1/type-2 adoption reverses.
Thesis: Vyjuvek commercial ramp, 95% gross margin, 45% op margin, no debt, revenue +24-32% y/y. Break: launch growth < 15% or pipeline failure; watch heavy insider selling.
Thesis: restaurant POS platform compounding revenue 22-25% every quarter with op margin rising 5%->8%; P/E 38 TTM, 18 fwd, below its band median. Break: net adds slow, growth < 18%.

Thesis: organ transplant logistics (OCS + aviation) with ROE 33% and P/E 16 TTM near 5-year band lows after a 39% fall. Break: case volumes stall, growth < 15%. High short interest (38%): sized smaller.

Thesis: memory interface chips for AI/DDR5 servers; 80% gross, 35% op margin, no debt, consensus +18-20% revenue. Break: chip revenue growth stalls. Note Argus has no quarterly revenue for it (tag gap).
Thesis: Wakix franchise growing 24% with 24% op margin at 5.6x forward EPS; cash-rich, pipeline optionality. Break: generic entry timing pulled forward or growth < 10%.
Thesis: industrial tech (aerospace/defense, utility test) growing 14-35% via acquisitions + organic, 20% insider ownership. Break: margins don't expand from 15% op margin.

Thesis: prenatal/oncology molecular diagnostics, revenue +64-117% y/y, already profitable at 71% gross margin; high multiple (P/E 126) so a starter position. Break: growth < 30% or margin compression.

[loop-growth] Starter 487 @ 14.35 (r002). Thesis: revenue +29-38% y/y for 6 straight quarters (SEC: Q2'26 $138.1M +32.5%), operating margin 23-39%, ROIC 23%. EV/EBITDA 18.1 at 8th pct and P/S 4.8 at 21st pct of own history; fwd P/E 18 on EPS est 0.60 -> 0.77. Insiders own ~83% (controlled company). Risks: near-zero book equity after debt-funded buybacks (P/B 2,900), insiders net sellers ($86M sold vs $9.3M bought). Break: growth below 20% or margin under 20% for two quarters.

[loop-growth] Starter 107 @ 56.00 (r002). Thesis: AI training-data services re-accelerating, revenue +54% and +58% y/y in Q1/Q2'26 (SEC), net margin ~16%, no debt, ROE 38%. H1'26 operating cash flow $164M (large customer prepayment in Q2). P/E 41 at its 5y median, fwd P/E 26; consensus target ~$123. Risks: customer concentration, insiders sold $175M in 12 months with no buys, short interest 14%, beta 3. Break: growth under 25% or loss of a top customer.
loop-income r003: yield 5.90% vs 10Y 5.13% (spread ~0.8 pp, thin). Payout 236% of GAAP EPS is not meaningful for a REIT; need AFFO. Hold at 4% target; revisit after Q3 report 11-02.

r004 macro: 5% of book moved from SGOV to IEF (55 @ 91.27). 10y rallied 19bp to 4.95% on a tech-led risk-off day (NDX -1.8%, VIX 19) while SPY -1.2% / TLT +1.9%: bonds hedging equities again. Housing slowdown + 7.4% mortgages argue the 5%+ long-end peak is in; IEF (7-10y) adds convexity vs a growth scare. Risk: hot PCE 10-29 / hawkish FOMC 10-28 reprices the long end; stop thinking if 10y > 5.25%.

Round 004 review: thesis on watch, not broken yet. Revenue growth slowed to +20.7% (Q2), Q2 net income 14.7M vs 34.9M a year ago, adjusted EPS missed; stock -40% YTD, below 50/200-day. Exit if Q3 (11-04/05) revenue growth < 15% or margins compress again.

loop-macro r005 (10-25): no trade. Gold -7.3% 1M, 1.8% above 52w low; 20d corr to SPY +0.54 (1y +0.38) so it is not hedging equities while real yields sit near 5% 10Y. Decide trim vs hold at 10-29 review after FOMC (10-28) and GDP/PCE (10-29).

[loop-growth] r005 pre-earnings (Q3 report 10-26 amc, est EPS 0.80 / rev 217.4M = ~+22% y/y vs 178.5M). Hold through. Exit if Q3 revenue growth < 12% y/y or product (chip) revenue falls q/q with guide below consensus. Note SEC data ends Q1'26 (stale), check the 10-Q/press release directly.

loop-income r006: added 1 sh @334.40 (post-market 10-26) to bring JPM back toward its 5% target with idle cash. Thesis unchanged: fortress balance sheet, dividend raised to 1.65/qtr in 2026, ~2% yield with high growth. Review after Q4 results / Dec ex-date; trim if CET1 falls or dividend growth stalls.

loop-income r006: added 1 sh @317.00 (post-market 10-26, -0.75% AH) to bring HD toward its 5% target with idle cash. Thesis: ~2.9% yield, steady dividend raises; housing turnover is the risk. Review at Q3 earnings mid-Nov; payout ratio above ~65% or a dividend freeze is the exit signal.

[loop-growth] r006 thesis update + add 25 sh @ 90.32 (cost now 121 sh @ 92.98, 11.25% of capital). Q3-26 (SEC): revenue 218.3M, +22.3% y/y (Q1 +8.1%, Q2 +20.4%: re-accelerating), op margin 38.3% vs 35.4% a year ago, FCF TTM 312.9M. Beat EPS 0.84 vs 0.80 adj; Q4 guide reported in-line (per headlines; Argus has no guidance). Thesis intact: memory interface chips riding DDR5/AI server, royalty base funds it. Exit if revenue growth < 12% y/y or op margin < 32% for two quarters. Max size 15% at cost; no more adds.

[loop-growth] r006 watch candidate (not bought). CTV performance-ad platform, mkt cap ~703M at 9.40, P/S 2.3, GM 81%, revenue +20.6% y/y Q2-26 (Q1 +14.2%), op margin 8.6% Q2 / 13% Q1 (was negative a year ago), no debt, insiders ~19.5%. P/E 12.8 is flattered by a Q4-25 tax item (NI 34.5M vs op income 20.5M); normalized ~20x. Risks: decelerating/lumpy growth, Q2 EPS miss, -40% 1y, insider selling 10.3M, no insider buys. Reports 11-04: buy a 4-6% starter if Q3 revenue growth >= 20% and op margin >= 10%; pass if growth < 15%.

loop-macro r006 (10-26): no trade. Pre-staged SELL 6 GLD / BUY 24 IEF (sim net cash +20.04, realized -67.80 on GLD). Case: 20d corr to SPY IEF -0.42 vs GLD +0.51; TLT +3.9% vs SPY 0.0% 20d; HYG-LQD -2.0pp; 10Y 4.99% (-17bp 1M). Trade cuts 1y book vol ~6.1%->5.7% (own calc). Execute after FOMC 10-28 + GDP/PCE 10-29 unless PCE runs hot and 10Y breaks back above 5.15%.

[loop-growth] r007 (10-27 close 44.74, -25.3% on the day, -20.1% on cost): reports of ~550 abrupt layoffs in India plus the Philippines, notices cite a 'ramp-down of the business assignment' (Research > News, brief headlines). Reads like a large customer program shrinking, which is the thesis-break risk (top-customer concentration), but nothing confirmed by the company. Decision: hold, no add, until the 11-05 Q3 report. Exit the whole position on 11-05 if the company confirms a top-customer ramp-down, if Q3 revenue growth < 25% y/y, or if the Q4 outlook implies < 25%. Analyst targets (mean 122.75) predate the news; ignore them.

loop-income r007: added 1 sh @91.23 (post-market 10-27) after Q3: EPS 0.91 vs 0.907 est, revenue 13.35B vs 13.31B (Argus brief). Stock -1.6% on the day, so yield 2.33% on Argus rate 2.12. Payout ~64% of EPS (rate / eps_ttm 3.33). Brings KO 3.84% -> 3.93% of a 4% target. Review after Q4 report / Feb raise.
